text:
Maria: Quick sync — planning changelog cutoff for SDK v1.4 + sampleapps. Cutoff is EOD Thu (Mar 19). Need owners and quick status: SDK packaging, docs, quickstarts, sample apps, changelog entry. Reply with 'take' + blockers.
Kevin: take — SDK packaging. Binary bump & size changes in PR #347. ETA tomorrow morning. One flaky e2e on mac but workaround available.
Lucy: taking docs. I'll land quickstart docs after Kevin cuts the package. Docs PR #512. Need updated screenshots (will coordinate).
Prasanna: take sampleapps (notebooks + node examples). Blocked on oauth creds for hosted demo env — @Jen can you grant demo-keys to team demo-service-account?
Jen: On it. Granting demo keys now, will DM creds. :white_check_mark:
Sahil: I'll own the changelog merge. Will stitch entries from SDK, docs, sampleapps. Plan to open changelog PR by Thu 10am PT — ping me when PRs are merged.
Kevin: CI note: `integration/e2e` failing on mac runner. Suspect flake in oauth flow. Workaround: rerun mac-e2e on CircleCI for now.
devex-bot: deploy-bot: build #1290 for sdk-package succeeded on linux-x86 at 2026-03-18T09:12:00Z
Prasanna: Thanks @Jen — once creds are in I'll flip sampleapp to use hosted creds and push PR. ETA today EOD.
Maria: Ok owners set. Quick checklist: Kevin -> merge #347 then cut release branch. Lucy -> update screenshots + docs PR. Prasanna -> sampleapps PR + smoke test. Sahil -> open changelog PR Thu 10am PT. If any delays please ping in-thread. :pray:
Kevin: One more ask — can we freeze feature flags in staging that touch telemetry? Packaging needs a stable API surface. @Maria?
Maria: @Kevin yes, I'll flip telemetry flags to stable for the release window at 5pm PT.
Lucy: Docs smoke: local quickstart fails on Node 18 because sampleapp missing dependency. Prasanna can we patch package.json in sampleapps? I'll add a note but prefer a fix in sampleapp repo.
Prasanna: Will patch now. Opening PR #88 for sampleapps package fix.
Sahil: Noted — I'll hold changelog PR until those PR numbers are listed. Please add short bullets for user-visible changes in PR descriptions.
Kevin: CI rerun passed on mac after removing flaky test. Merging #347 now. Cutting release branch `v1.4-rc` in 10m.
devex-bot: release-bot: branch v1.4-rc created by Kevin at 2026-03-18T10:03:00Z
Jen: Creds DM sent to Prasanna.
Prasanna: sampleapps PR #88 opened and linked to SDK #347. Smoke tests passing in staging. https://github.com/redwood/sampleapps/pull/88
Sahil: Changelog PR opened: #622 with entries stubbed. Will update with final PR numbers before Thu 10am. https://github.com/redwood/changelog/pull/622
Maria: Sweet. Everyone, please add a one-sentence user-facing summary to your PR body (helps changelog). I'll follow up in the morning if anything slips. Thanks all :rocket:
